answer.reason: The verses tell of Tubal as a trading land and as a place to which the LORD would send survivors, so a short line is possible.

clauses.english: traded men and vessels of brass as a merchant
clauses.quote: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants

clauses.english: was a land to which the LORD would send survivors to declare his glory
clauses.quote: to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off

doubts: EZK 38:2-3 and EZK 39:1 name Tubal only as part of the domain of Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, against whom the LORD set himself; I left them out because the deed is Gog's, not Tubal's.
EZK 27 does not name the city whose market is meant in the verses given, so it is left unnamed.
